summary_ja: 相対ネッティング下の複数のレポ取引等の信用リスク削減手法適用後エクスポージャー額を、ネット・エクスポージャー及びグロス・エクスポージャーを用いた算式で算出する。
summary_en: Exposure for netted repo sets: E* = (ΣE − ΣC) + 0.4 × net exposure + 0.6 × gross exposure / √N + Σ(Efx × Hfx).
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach takes into account the effect of a bilateral netting contract for multiple repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions that satisfy the conditions of the preceding Article and are under a legally effective bilateral netting contract, it shall calculate the exposure amount after credit risk mitigation by the following formula. E^{*} = (ΣE − ΣC) + 0.4 × net exposure + 0.6 × (gross exposure / √N) + Σ(Efx × Hfx) E^{*} is the exposure amount after credit risk mitigation of those multiple repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions (provided that it shall not be below zero). ΣE is the total market value of the assets provided to the counterparty in those transactions. ΣC is the total market value of the assets received from the counterparty in those transactions. Net exposure is the absolute value of the amount calculated as Σ(Es × Hs). Gross exposure is the amount calculated as Σ(Es × |Hs|). √N is the square root of N, the number of securities included in the netting set (provided that securities whose Es is less than ten percent of the largest Es in the netting set are not counted in N). Es is the absolute value of the market value of the net position in each security. Hs is, where the market value of the net position in a security is positive, the haircut to be applied to that security, and where it is negative, the haircut to be applied to that security multiplied by minus one. |Hs| is the absolute value of Hs. Efx is the absolute value of the amount of the net position in each currency that is in a currency other than the settlement currency. Hfx is the haircut applied where the currencies of the exposure and eligible financial collateral differ.
